runMethylTFR

Source: R/run_methyltfr.R
runMethylTFR.Rd

Compute bias-corrected deviation scores for every motif and every sample listed in a sample annotation file.

Usage

runMethylTFR(
  sample_ann,
  sample_dir,
  tf_bindsites = NULL,
  gcfreqs = NULL,
  gc_dist = NULL,
  sampleColName = "bedFile",
  chunkSize = 20,
  full_path = FALSE,
  annfile = NULL,
  threads = 1,
  enhancer = NULL,
  filetype = NULL,
  ignoreStrand = TRUE,
  cov_threshold = 1,
  tempDir = file.path(tempdir(), "methylTFR")
)

Arguments

sample_ann

Name of a tab-separated (.tsv) or comma-separated (.csv) sample annotation file in sample_dir. It must have a header and contain the column named by sampleColName, which holds the methylation file names. All columns are kept as colData of the result. Not used when annfile is given.

sample_dir

Directory holding the methylation call files (and, usually, the sample annotation file).

tf_bindsites

A GRangesList named by motif. Each element is a GRanges of the occurrences of that motif. The names must include every name in names(gcfreqs). Get it with getTFbindsites(motifSet = "jaspar2020") from the methylTFRAnnotationHg38 (or methylTFRAnnotationMm10) package, or build a custom set with methylTFRAnnotationBuilder.

gcfreqs

A named list with one element per motif, named as in tf_bindsites. Each element is a numeric matrix with the five GC bins in rows and the positions across the binding-site window in columns. Get it with getGCfreq(motifSet = ...) from the annotation package.

gc_dist

A GRanges object of 30-bp genomic windows with an integer metadata column GC_bin (1 to 5). Get it with getGenomeGC() from the annotation package.

sampleColName

Name of the column in sample_ann that holds the methylation file names. Default "bedFile".

chunkSize

Number of motifs processed together in one block. Default 20.

full_path

Logical. If TRUE, the file names in sampleColName are full paths and sample_dir is not prepended. Default FALSE.

annfile

Optional path to the sample annotation file. If given, it is used instead of sample_ann in sample_dir.

threads

Number of workers used to process the motifs of a chunk in parallel. Default 1 (serial).

enhancer

An optional GRanges object of regions, for example distal regulatory elements. Binding sites outside these regions are dropped. Any region set imported as GRanges works, for example the ENCODE candidate cis-regulatory elements (SCREEN) read with rtracklayer::import(). Default NULL uses all binding sites.

filetype

Format of the methylation call files, one of "bissnp", "epp", "allc", "bismarkCytosine", "bismarkCov" or "encode" (case-insensitive). See readMethylome.

ignoreStrand

Logical. If TRUE (default), strand is ignored when overlapping methylation sites with annotations.

cov_threshold

Numeric. Sites with fewer reads than this are dropped. Default 1.

tempDir

Directory for the temporary HDF5 files written during a run. Default is a folder under tempdir(). The files are deleted when the run finishes.

Value

A methylTFRdeviations object with the assays deviations, z and expected, motifs in rows and samples in columns.

Details

Each sample is read with readMethylome, binned by GC content with addGCBinToMethylome and scored per motif with computeDeviation.

See also

runMethylTFRFromRnBeads for running methylTFR directly on a preprocessed RnBeads object, deviations and deviationZScores to extract the scores.

Examples

# A minimal end-to-end run on the BATF example data bundled with the
# package. The annotation objects cover a single motif, so the result
# has one row.
load(system.file("extdata", "example_data.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "BATF_tf_bindsites.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "BATF_gcfreqs.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "gcdist_subset.rda", package = "methylTFR"))

# runMethylTFR() reads per-sample calls from disk, so the bundled sites
# are written out as a bismarkCov file first.
sample_dir <- tempfile("methylTFR_example")
dir.create(sample_dir)
n_meth <- round(msites$score * msites$coverage)
write.table(
    data.frame(
        chr = as.character(GenomicRanges::seqnames(msites)),
        start = GenomicRanges::start(msites),
        end = GenomicRanges::end(msites),
        percent = msites$score * 100,
        meth = n_meth,
        unmeth = msites$coverage - n_meth
    ),
    file.path(sample_dir, "sample_1.cov"),
    sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)
write.table(
    data.frame(sampleName = "sample_1", bedFile = "sample_1.cov"),
    file.path(sample_dir, "samples.tsv"),
    sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)

devs <- runMethylTFR(
    sample_ann = "samples.tsv",
    sample_dir = sample_dir,
    tf_bindsites = tf_bindsites,
    gcfreqs = gcfreqs,
    gc_dist = gcdist,
    filetype = "bismarkCov"
)
#> SUCCESS [2026-11-09 15:29:14] The samples are successfully located

deviations(devs)

unlink(sample_dir, recursive = TRUE)
